candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately if any internal call succeeds (invert success check), causing return value to differ when calls succeed but not revert.
Return the success flag of the last internal call instead of always true, so return differs when any calls fail or succeed.
Ignore call success (remove require) and return true only if all calls succeeded by tracking successes, changing return value when calls fail but do not revert.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, so the transferred call executes in this contract's context and may affect this contract's storage/behavior observed via transfer.
Invert the require on the call success so that it requires the inner call to fail (i.e., require(!_s)), changing which outcomes revert and thus the observable result of transfer.
Remove the require that _tos.length > 0 so transfer can succeed with empty _tos, altering observable behavior when called with an empty array.
